brand_identity.name: Aether Digital
brand_identity.archetype: The Performance Pro / Jewel Luxury Hybrid
brand_identity.theme_strategy: Hybrid (Primary: Deep Space Dark Mode for 'Ultra Modern' feel, Toggleable Light Mode)
brand_identity.description: A digital agency that doesn't just build websites, but constructs digital realities. We blend engineering precision with artistic chaos.

gradients.text_gradient: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-indigo-100 to-indigo-300

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating modals, dashboard cards

textures.noise: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay with opacity-5 on dark backgrounds to prevent banding.

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_rules: Always use 'col-span' variations. Never equal squares. Mix 2:1, 1:1, and 1:2 aspect ratios.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-white text-black font-bold hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors duration-200
buttons.glow: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,70,229,0.7)] transition-all

cards.service_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 p-8 hover:border-indigo-500/50 transition-colors
cards.pricing_card: flex flex-col p-8 rounded-3xl bg-slate-900/50 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform

inputs.style: bg-slate-950/50 border-white/10 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 rounded-xl h-12

images.description: Abstract glass sculpture for Hero background or 'About' header
Group meeting in white boardroom - Use for About Us or Careers
Dark mode code screen - Use for Development Services card
Laptop with graphs - Use for Marketing Services card
Confident woman leader - Use for 'Message from CEO' or About page
3D Blue Blocks - Use for 'Our Process' or footer background

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Use distinct colors (Indigo/Cyan) for icons.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for dark colors. Use solid deep colors.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-12, py-24).

checklist: Ensure text contrast ratio > 4.5:1 on dark backgrounds.
Focus states must be visible (ring-2 ring-indigo-500).

instructions_to_main_agent: Start by setting up the theme in tailwind.config.js and index.css with the provided colors. Then build the Layout wrapper with the Navbar and Footer. Focus on the Home page first, using the Hero/Abstract image for a massive hero section. Use the Bento grid pattern for the 'Services' section. Implement the 'Project Submission' page with a multi-step form using Shadcn components but styled with the 'Performance Pro' aesthetic.
